name: model-effort-presets
description: One press above the prompt switches the model and the effort together: a plan preset, an execute preset, or your own, also by /preset <name> or when you send a mapped command.

presets.title: Presets
presets.description: Comma-separated name=model/effort, one per preset. The model is what /model takes (opus, sonnet, haiku or an id); the effort is low, medium, high, xhigh or max.

commands.title: Commands that switch
commands.description: Comma-separated command=preset (lril:plan-feature=plan). Sending one of these commands applies its preset before the command runs; empty switches on no command.
